Provenance
==========

Origin: SYNTHETIC (hand-authored)
Date:   2026-05-21
Author: costa (B3 Phase 2 batch 1)

x.com has path-sensitive selector logic in suggest_selector:

  /status/ URLs        → returns '[data-testid="tweet"]'
  /<username>          → returns "" (profile page, viewport screenshot)
  /<username>/likes    → returns "" (same)

This fixture exercises the /status/ branch — the most common screenshot
target for articles (citing specific tweets, not profile snapshots).

HOST_MAIN_SELECTORS["x.com"] lists:

  article[data-testid='tweet']  — preferred (article-wrapped, most specific)
  [data-testid='tweet']         — fallback (any tweet element)

The fixture has TWO data-testid='tweet' articles — primary + a reply.
This tests "first match" semantics: the primary tweet wins, the reply
doesn't pollute the bounding box.

For twitter.com (legacy redirect), the same HOST_MAIN_SELECTORS entry
is reused — no separate fixture needed.
